name: Provenance
description: Who set each own field last, and through what (D73): a caller's create or update, or the behavior whose operation wrote it, with the confidence that operation attributed (D16, amended). With review, a write from the sources it names is proposed until a reviewer holding its permission accepts or rejects it, unless its confidence reaches below; a caller's write over a proposal makes it edited. A gate refuses a move of the type's Workflow into its state while a field it lists is proposed. Deleting the instance deletes its records.

fields.description: The own top-level fields it records; every one when absent.

review.description: Which writes enter review, and who reviews them.

sources.description: The behaviors whose writes enter review, each one the type composes.

below.description: A confidence at or above which a write is accepted with no reviewer; every write from a source is proposed when absent.

permission.description: The permission a reviewer needs to accept or reject.

gates.description: By state of the type's Workflow, the fields a move into it requires out of review.

reviewed.description: The recorded fields that must not be proposed, or all.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: By recorded field written since Provenance was added: { source, by, at, confidence?, review? }. source is caller for a caller's create or update, else the name of the behavior whose operation wrote it; by is the principal's subject; review is { state, by?, at? }, state proposed, accepted, rejected or edited.

fields.name: inReview
fields.description: Whether any recorded field is proposed. A list filters on it.

operations.name: accept
operations.description: Accepts proposed fields as they are, as the caller. Needs the review's permission.

operations.name: reject
operations.description: Rejects proposed fields: clears each, or sets it to the patch's value, through update(), as the caller's own write, so Derived does not propose it again. Needs the review's permission.

patch.description: Replacement values, by field of fields; a field it leaves out is cleared.

vetoes.description: accept or reject of a field Provenance does not record, or a reject patch that sets another field.
accept or reject of a field that is not proposed.
A transition into a gated state while a field the gate lists is proposed.
